title: Grief Counseling
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office learns of the death of Ed Truck, Michael's former boss, which prompts Michael to try to lead the office through grief. Conflicts arise over how to properly honor Ed Truck, including disagreements about giving the office a day off. Michael attempts to facilitate grief counseling sessions, including a ball-toss exercise, but faces resistance and emotional challenges. Meanwhile, Dwight organizes a small funeral for a dead bird, which some office members participate in. The episode explores themes of grief, denial, and the varied ways individuals cope with loss.
